meta.description: Full authoritative league history for Sunday Funday, 2012-2025, combining ESPN (2012-2018, league ID 561849) and Sleeper (2019-2025) sources.
meta.generated: pulled directly from ESPN leagueHistory API (authenticated) and Sleeper public API

corrections_applied.note: ESPN raw API data (single-week rankCalculatedFinal + week-16 score of 170-155 to jphn744) appears to show jphn744 as champion. This is INCORRECT — confirmed by the user (league participant) that 2015 was an anomaly year where the championship spanned two weeks with scores manually combined by the league outside ESPN's own bracket system, and peterbrune actually won. ESPN's automated bracket has no record of this manual combination. The original site data (peterbrune=Champion, jphn744=Runner-Up) is CORRECT and has been preserved. Do not 'auto-correct' this season's result from raw ESPN API data in the future.

Playoff win/loss records now count only championship-bracket and qualifier placement games (ESPN WINNERS_BRACKET + WINNERS_CONSOLATION_LADDER; Sleeper winners_bracket). Toilet-bowl games (ESPN LOSERS_CONSOLATION_LADDER, Sleeper losers_bracket) are flagged consolation:true and excluded from playoff records. Sleeper losers-bracket results were also corrected: Sleeper's 'w' field there tracks bracket advancement, not who won the game.

TylerKeel's 2012 and 2013 rows, and dnevels8's 2015 row, were misattributed during the original ESPN-era curation. Verified directly against ESPN's raw leagueHistory API member list (view=mTeam): 2012 and 2013's roster slot 7 belonged to Keith Robertson (new identity: KRobertson), who left before Tyler Keel joined as an unrelated new franchise in 2014. 2015's roster slot 12 belonged to Andy Engler (amenr5), a one-season manager who left before Devin Nevels took over that slot in 2016. Do not re-fold these into TylerKeel/dnevels8's continuous history if ever regenerating from raw ESPN pulls.
